name: Specialty Automotive Supply
old_description: At Specialty Automotive Supply, we're passionate about enhancing your vehicle's performance and appearance. For over two decades, we've been the trusted name in Marlborough, Massachusetts and surrounding areas for all things automotive. Our expertise spans a wide range of services, from rugged truck bed liners to stylish car accessories. We pride ourselves on offering premium products for all makes and models, backed by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Whether you're looking to protect your truck bed or add a personal touch to your car, our team of seasoned professionals is here to help. With competitive pricing and a local touch, we're dedicated to transforming your automotive vision into reality.
about:
Specialty Automotive Supply operates in Marlborough, Massachusetts, where it has served the surrounding area for over two decades. The locally owned business was established to provide automotive accessories and installation services, though the exact founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in selling and professionally installing a range of automotive accessories for all makes and models. Its product lineup includes spray-on and drop-in truck bed liners, tonneau covers, side steps, exhaust systems, suspension upgrades, custom seat covers, floor mats, spoilers, and window tints. It carries brands such as WeatherTech and Westin. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are disclosed.

Specialty Automotive Supply primarily serves individual vehicle owners in the Marlborough, Massachusetts area seeking to enhance their trucks or cars with accessories and protective liners. The business caters to all makes and models, offering both retail sales and professional installation.

The company emphasizes its local ownership, personalized service, and use of high-quality products as differentiators from larger retailers. It cites over 20 years of industry experience and a satisfaction guarantee on all products and services.
